title: Blue Harbour Exports v. Joint Commissioner (Refunds)

brief.about: The appeal is against rejection of a refund claim of Rs. 42,10,000 for the quarter ending June 2021 on the ground that shipping bills were filed late. Issue notice.
brief.last: Arguments of both sides heard at length. The appellant relied on the circular dated 18.11.2021 extending time for filing. The respondent says the circular applies only prospectively.

orders.summary: The appeal is against rejection of a refund claim of Rs. 42,10,000 for the quarter ending June 2021 on the ground that shipping bills were filed late. Issue notice.
Reply and rejoinder are on record. The respondent is directed to place the verification report of the shipping bills on file.
directions: The respondent is directed to place the verification report of the shipping bills on file.
